name: Trench Dispatch #1 — April 2026 Rules Updates
_note: Transcribed from the extracted Dispatch text, not interpreted from it.
The document is already written as errata operations ('Add the FUMBLE
Keyword to: …', 'Change the Cost of Incendiary Grenades to 10 …'), so each
op below quotes the line it came from in _src.
The Dispatch describes itself as an unofficial fan compilation of official
Trench Wire updates, and most of it is marked Public Beta — hence
status: public-beta, which a ruleset can exclude.
INCOMPLETE. This covers the mechanical changes that map cleanly onto the
Grail Strains transcribed (4). Their rules text is verbatim from the extracted
Dispatch. Their COSTS needed a maintainer ruling: the PDF prints the currency as a glyph and
the text extraction drops it, so a bare number is all that survives. Ops whose
maintainer confirmed against the printed page carry _costCurrencyConfirmed. All four
are Ducats. Still to transcribe: the Amalgam and Grail Thrall entry
replacements (full statlines), and the Mercenary keyword rewrites.
The Dispatch's 'Grail Thrall' is the catalogues' 'Thrall'. The Strains ops target
the catalogue name. Note the Dispatch extends Strains to Thralls, which the
catalogues currently offer only to the Matagot Hag and Gregori Gula.

ability.name: Mubarizun
ability.description: A Yüzbaşı is expected to face the mightiest of their enemies in personal combat, inspiring the troops to victory with their personal prowess. Add +1 INJURY DICE for attacks made by a Yüzbaşı if the target model has the TOUGH Keyword.

ops._src: p.9 — Mubarizun

ability.name: Living Battering Ram ACTION
ability.description: If a Brazen Bull takes a Charge ACTION and ends its charge move within 1” of any enemy models, it can immediately take a Living Battering Ram ACTION. If it does so, make a Success Roll for each enemy model within 1” of the Brazen Bull. Add -1 DICE to the Success Roll if the enemy model is on a base that is 40mm or larger. On a failure, nothing happens. On a Success or a Critical Success, the enemy model is immediately taken Down.

ops._src: p.10 — Living Battering Ram ACTION

entity.name: FUMBLE
entity.description: If the Success Roll for an attack made with a Weapon that has the FUMBLE Keyword is 2 or less, then the attacking model fumbles the attack and hits themselves instead of the target. Treat the attack as a successful attack made by the Weapon that targeted the attacking model.

ops._src: p.2 — Grenades > Keywords > FUMBLE

entity.name: MERCENARY
entity.description: This model is a Mercenary and can be recruited by various Factions. Mercenaries do not benefit from Faction special rules that refer to ‘models in a [Faction] Warband’, such as the New Antioch Concentrated Attack rule, including Warband Variant special rules. They do count as friendly models for the purposes of other rules used by their Warband unless stated otherwise. In a campaign, this includes counting towards Threshold Limits and Field Strength, completing Glorious Deeds, rolling on the Trauma Table for them if they are ELITE and taken Out of Action, being Promoted and gaining Experience Points, and so on.
